Bisher erhaltene Abrechnungen der Leistungserbringer und/oder deren Dienstleistern, die in Papierform eingehen, sollen durch den Auftragnehmer digitalisiert und so der Auftraggeberin zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Pri posameznem podizvajalcu ne smejo obstajati razlogi za izključitev oziroma mora izpolnjevati vse pogoje iz obrazcev dokumentacije javnega naročila. Če ponudnik nastopa v ponudbi s podizvajalcem, mora: - navesti vse podizvajalce ter vsak del javnega naročila, ki ga namerava oddati v podizvajanje; - navesti kontaktne podatke in zakonite zastopnike predlaganih podizvajalcev; - priložiti ESPD podizvajalca; Odprti postopek oddaje javnega naročila: Najem in vzdrževanje sistemske programske opreme verzija 6 Stran 6 od 48 -če se ponudnik nanje sklicuje, predložiti tudi dokazilo o uporabi zmogljivosti drugih subjektov; - priložiti zahtevo podizvajalca za neposredno plačilo, če podizvajalec to zahteva (Obrazec 1, III. točka). Ponudnik mora za podizvajalca priložiti sledeče izpolnjene obrazce: - Obrazec 3: Izjava o sprejemanju razpisnih pogojev, - Obrazec 4: Pooblastilo za pridobitev podatkov iz uradnih evidenc, - Obrazec 5: Izjava o udeležbi fizičnih in pravnih oseb v lastništvu ponudnika, - Obrazec 6: Ekonomska in finančna sposob

o in vsak posebej v celoti. Skupni ponudniki brez naročnikovega predhodnega pisnega dovoljenja pisnega dogovora med skupnimi ponudniki ne smejo spreminjati. V primeru skupne ponudbe podpisnikom ni potrebno priložiti Obrazca 3 (Izjava o sprejemanju razpisnih pogojev). Nosilec ponudbe mora za vsakega partnerja v skupnem nastopu priložiti: - Obrazec 2: Izjava skupnih ponudnikov, - Obrazec 4: Pooblastilo za pridobitev podatkov iz uradnih evidenc, - Obrazec 5: Izjava o udeležbi fizičnih in pravnih oseb v lastništvu ponudnika, - Obrazec 6: Ekonomska in finančna sposobnost, - Obrazec 7: Izjava o integriteti poslovnih subjektov in - izpolnjen ESPD. Językiem obowiązującym w kontaktach pomiędzy Zamawiającym a Wykonawcą oraz innymi osobami, którymi Wykonawca posługuje się przy wykonaniu zobowiązań wynikających z Umowy, jest język polski. Wykonawca zobowiązuje się realizować Umowę z zachowaniem zasad bezpieczeństwa teleinformatycznego oraz dobrych praktyk w zakresie cyberbezpieczeństwa. Zamawiający ma prawo przeprowadzić samodzielnie lub przy pomocy podmiotu trzeciego audyt bezpieczeństwa Systemu, obejmujący w szczególności ocenę bezpieczeństwa konfiguracji, mechanizmów uwierzytelniania, autoryzacji oraz ochrony danych. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Meath C15 N67E via email to procurement@lmetb.ie with the following subject heading: Application for Panel Membership for the Provision of Suitable Sites for Adventure Trips for LMETB students. Queries All queries regarding this Panel Application should be submitted via www.etenders.gov.ie. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. Gewenste kennis • Uitgebreide kennis

er Service, Sales, Omnichannel, Customer Insights – Journeys, Customer Voice en Copilot- functionaliteiten evenals de bijbehorende integratie-, Dataverse- en Power Platform- functionaliteiten. • Architectuur, governance en solution design binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Microsoft Power Platform. • Kennis van softwarearchitectuurprincipes, integratiearchitectuur en solution governance. • Kennis van de andere Microsoft 365-componenten (SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Exchange Online, Teams, …) en de integraties met Microsoft Dynamics 365. • Projectbeheer en projectmanagement: beheren van prestaties, timing, budget, correcte inschattingen kunnen maken en het tijdig rapporteren van knelpunten, risico’s. • Procesanalyse- en modellering: kennis van modellerings- en analysemethodieken. • Kennis van Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Power Platform. • Kennis van Microsoft .NET Framework en moderne .NET-platformen (.NET Core, .NET 6 of hoger) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van programmeertalen (C#, JavaScript, TypeScript) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van Azure-integratiecomponenten zoals Azure Functions, Logic Apps en API Management, evenals REST API's, Microsoft Entra ID en cloudnative integrati

Established under the Health Act 2004, it is responsible for delivering health and personal social services to people living in Ireland, including hospital care, disability services, primary care, mental health services, social care, and health promotion. Six regional areas are in place to improve integration of hospital and community services. MISSION The HSE’s mission is to ensure that people in Ireland are supported by health and social care services so that they can: - Access safe, compassionate, and high-quality care when they need it - Achieve the best possible health outcomes - Have confidence that public resources are used effectively and responsibly VALUES The HSE operates according to four core values that guide its culture and behaviour: Care Providing high-quality, evidence-based healthcare while listening to service users’ needs and experiences. Compassion Treating people with dignity, kindness, respect, and empathy, and communicating openly and professionally. Trust Acting with honesty, integrity, transparency, and accountability to build public confidence. Learning Supporting continuous improvement, innovation, and staff development while learning from experience. Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Cross-Site Scripting) - saugumo pažeidimas, kai kenkėjiški skriptai įterpiami į svetainę, kad būtų pavogta vartotojo informacija CSRF | Kryžminė užklausų klastojimo ataka (angl. Cross-Site Request Forgery) - saugumo pažeidimas, kai vartotojas netyčia atlieka nepageidaujamus veiksmus svetainėje, kurioje yra prisijungęs OAuth2 | Atviras autorizacijos protokolas 2.0 (angl. Open Authorization 2.0) - standartas, leidžiantis programoms saugiai gauti ribotą prieigą prie vartotojo duomenų be slaptažodžio dalijimosi JSON | JavaScript objektų notacija (duomenų mainų formatas) (angl. JavaScript Object Notation) - lengvas duomenų formatas, naudojamas struktūruotai informacijai perduoti tarp serverio ir kliento, lengvai skaitomas tiek žmogui, tiek mašinai JWT | JSON interneto žetonas (angl. JSON Web Token) - saugus būdas perduoti vartotojo tapatybę ir teises tarp klientų ir serverių LDAP | Lengvasis katalogų prieigos protokolas (angl. Pri ocenjevanju ukrepov, ki jih sprejme gospodarski subjekt, naročnik upošteva resnost in posebne okoliščine kaznivega dejanja ali kršitve. For more information on ETBs and ETBI go to www.etbi.ie For more information on LMETB go to www.lmetb.ie Scope of the Service Required under the Panel The Contracting Authority proposes to engage in a Light Touch process, in line with Annex XIV of EU Directive 2014/24/EU, for the establishment of a panel from which it will source service providers for the provision of suitable sites for Nationwide adventure trips for LMETB students; whether day trips, one over night or two over nights including weekends, or as required by the school/centre. Please note that a number of LMETB Schools have Special Needs Units (SNUs) on site for students with Autism and there will be a requirement for those students to have specific activities suited to their needs and may need adaptations such as low lighting, quieter music etc Numbers Admitted to the Panel There will be no restrictions to the number of applicants who can qualify for the panel. Duration of the Panel The duration of the panel will be three years, subject to satisfactory annual review of performance by the Contracting Authority. Awarding Contracts under the Panel In the case of this multi-party panel contracts will be awarded as follows: Louth Meath Education & Training Board will consult the members of the panel and pick the most appropriate member on the basis of the following criteria: Duration of trip required Ability to facilitate group size Availability of proposed date(s) Requirements of the group (new venue, new adventure experience) On this basis the most appropriate candidate will be approached and offered the assignment, where they are not in a position to fulfil the requirement the next appropriate candidate will be contacted and offered the assignment. Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. However, there is no obligation upon the Contracting Authority to make use of this panel. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. tick_contract: After GPT Web reviews a pass, add one durable reviewed tick per candidate to control/gpt_web_review_ledger.json. The next rebuild removes ticked rows automatically. A later DCE run may re-enter review.
final_bank_contract: Decided GREEN/YELLOW/RED/FINAL_SUPER_GREEN results belong in control/final_supergreen_bank.json, never mixed into this inbox.
pipeline_contract: harvest -> rich-context Qwen triage -> DCE/evidence with document provenance -> deterministic post-DCE scope gate -> fair-share GPT Web inbox -> GPT Web review + tick -> final bank.
